reason: ^SSH container fixtures unavailable: (no container runtime available|the docker daemon runs windows containers)
why: SSH suites that need a fixture-specific Docker sshd (banner, MFA, sudo/no-sudo, X11, SFTP-only host): the native sshd fixture cannot stand in. The hosted macOS runners ship no container runtime; on Windows the daemon runs only Windows containers or never comes up (#4842). Counted from the skips of the 2026-11-11 develop nightly (dispatch 43006910579) minus the suites #5176 re-points at the native sshd; the cap fails the lane when one more suite skips for this reason.
